description: This file defines the 'MacNodeRuntime' actor, which handles various system operations for a macOS application, including command invocation, device management, location services, screen recording, executing system commands, and interfacing with UI elements and permissions within the application. It includes methods for processing different types of commands, managing permissions, and communicating with other services/components.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: An actor that manages various system and device interactions for the macOS environment, including command handling, device management, location services, screen recording, permissions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used for session-based operations.

methods.name: setEventSender
methods.description: Sets the callback function to send events.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main method for handling various command requests received by the runtime.

methods.name: isCanvasCommand
methods.description: Determines if a command is related to canvas operations.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to canvas operations like present, hide, navigate, evalJS, and snapshot.

methods.name: handleA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to A2UI push and reset.

methods.name: handleBrowserProxyInvoke
methods.description: Handles browser proxy commands and forwards requests.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Handles camera commands such as snap, clip, and list devices.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location-related commands, fetching current location and permissions.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Handles screen recording commands.

methods.name: mainActorServices
methods.description: Provides cached or newly fetched main actor services.

methods.name: handleA2UIReset
methods.description: Resets the A2UI component via JavaScript eval.

methods.name: handleA2UIPush
methods.description: Pushes messages to the A2UI component.

methods.name: ensureA2UIHost
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI host is available and reachable.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the URL for the A2UI host.

methods.name: isA2UIReady
methods.description: Checks if the A2UI component is ready, polling as needed.

methods.name: handleSystemRun
methods.description: Handles running a system command, including approval and permission checks.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Handles locating system binaries.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunApproval
methods.description: Resolves whether a system run command is approved or denied based on user prompts and policies.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsGet
methods.description: Retrieves current system execution approval state.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsSet
methods.description: Sets the system execution approval configuration.

methods.name: emitExecEvent
methods.description: Emits system execution related events to event sender.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks if screen recording permission is granted if needed, and emits denial events if not.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
methods.description: Executes a system command and reports the result, emitting events accordingly.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a specific Decodable type.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes a given object into a JSON string.

methods.name: canvasEnabled
methods.description: Checks if canvas feature is enabled (read from UserDefaults).

methods.name: cameraEnabled
methods.description: Checks if camera feature is enabled.

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Retrieves the location mode setting.

methods.name: locationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Checks if precise location is enabled.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Creates an error response object for a given request.

methods.name: encodeCanvasSnapshot
methods.description: Encodes an NSImage to PNG or JPEG format with specified quality and size constraints.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales an NSImage to a maximum width, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: persistAllowlistPatterns
methods.description: Persists allowlist patterns if allowed.

methods.name: recordAllowlistMatches
methods.description: Records matches to an allowlist after command execution.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Verifies if screen recording permission is granted when required.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
methods.description: Runs the system command asynchronously and handles output and events.
